I'm bringing into your attention guys The first in history absolutely decentralized matrix project That is called Forsage What is decentralized and what does it give you? The marketing plan in Forsage is made on a SMART contract SMART contract gives you maximum security and sustainability smart contract is an algorithm in blockchain of one of the cryptocurrency and in this case we have the leader of smart contracts because this project is based on a theory of smart contract smart contract just like cryptocurrencies is decentralized all the agreements and rules of smart Contract put in the program become unchanged. Because of that the members are confidently growing their business. For this reason, your growth is not limited by the risks of an ordinary project. The cycles repeat by filling the matrix and reinvestments. The logic for filling the matrix with reinvestments is simple. It is based on the referral bonds. Your third partner always follows you in each slot. On Forsage Three, you have one line with three spots. On Forsage X4, you have two lines with four spots. Two spots in line one and four spots in line two. Upon registration on Forsage, you have two programs open to you simultaneously. Each of these slots, X3 and X4, we have 12 slots. They are all identical and work in identical similar way. Each of the slots is twice as expensive as the previous and therefore the income and profit from them is twice as higher as well. All active slots, they move and bring you income simultaneously. How many slots you can activate immediately? However many you want. You can activate all 12 if you want. Or all 24 slots. They don't expire, so you don't need to be afraid that they will get burnt. The recommendation is to start with 3 slots in each of the matrices. But leaders they put from the starts many more slots. For Sagi 3 is shorter and it's getting filled quicker and with active partners. They have more profits. In most cases you have your personal referred members when you invite partners, they take places below you. You also can have spillover if your partners move ahead. Therefore, it is beneficial to take places in the slots as soon as possible fill in the matrix and payouts are as follows your first partner comes after you and his purchase of the slot 100% of it goes directly to your personal ethereum wallet second takes place under you and the payment also comes instantly to your ethereum wallet a hundred percent of it when the third person takes the third spot you get 100% income, but now in the form of reinvestment. Reinvestment opens to you the same slot again and you continue to get income from it. When your partners get to reinvest, the slot is being open up to them again and they got the free spot to you. So 100% of the reinvest, you get 100% of it to your Wallet. There is a situation where your partner is more active than you. For example, he takes the first spot in your slot, the second spot you still get is free. And the partner already fills his slot and goes to reinvest. So, he fills your 2nd spot. So, it is possible that one active partner creates a movement of income for you Now how the Forsage x4 works Parallely to x3 you have the x4 program It's also working for it's very lucrative because of the spillover You can have your different variations of filling the matrix you can have it filled with all of your personal referrals, or it can be filled by spillover. The income from X4, we get from the second line. Partners that take the spots beneath you are the two spots in the second line of your upline. Income from these two spots 100% goes to your upline. The last payment closes the slot and it produces reinvestments and buys you the same slot again. Your partners also reinvest and 100% of that income for that slot goes to your wallet. Because of the system of Reinvestments, opening the slot once continue earning constantly like your partner passive income and will continue to make profits from it. Reinvestments go automatically as soon as the last spot is filled, the current slots closes and goes to archive. Partner after the reinvestment takes again the spot, that is free in this slot of the upline, and new slot has been open with three spots and one hundred percent of the payments of your referrals, go to your wallet. This way the income from the reinvestments from each platform can be unlimited. We have in the program, 12 slots in Forsage X3 and Forsage X, and we're going to make income from all of the slots. So that's why we have upgrades. Upgrade is the opening of more expensive slot. Upgrade happens with any slot 2 to 12. Upgrade is necessary so that your partners will move up to you and the turnover from your team will grow. So how to motivate your team? In other matrices, there is a centralized leverage or auto upgrade, so people upgrade automatically. To do that you need to collect two payments and the funds are being stored in a centralized location. But this money in the system that is centralized violates the principles and is not in congruence with the 100% of payment that goes to you and in Forsage 100% of the payments go to the partners. Each payment goes directly to the wallet of one of the participants. In Forsage they tackle the issue of upgrades differently. Income from each slot is enough for reinvestment and also for the purchase of the next level. Upgrades are done by partners and reinvestment and also for the purchase of the next level. Upgrades are done by partners, and reinvestment is made automatically. For it, you don't have to collect the funds. If the member he doesn't have the next slot open to him after the second reinvestment, all payments will be sent to the upline. To get the payments after reinvestment you need to do an upgrade. You don't have to wait for the reinvestment to happen but you can upgrade right away after the first two Reinvestments after the first two payments so that he will be in the next level slot before your upline and partners spillover getting ahead You can get ahead of your upline by getting the slot for which he didn't arrive yet This way you get to his upline that this slot is available. This way the personal referral bond is strong and forever as you can see in the matrix, every action gives you an immediate result and you have growth all the time. Turn on the money machine and earn a lot of Ethereum. Let's see how much income you can generate with Forsage. For example, in the first week you have the first slot cycle.
